label: Most blessed: primitive beatitude versus perfect intellectual being in act in understanding
resolution: The Dei Filius attributes (blessed conjunct) and the bridge 'Whatever is PERFECT_2 and HAS_INTELLECT_1 is BLESSED_1' use BLESSED_1, the primitive Primitives.MostBlessed (having in and from itself the perfect good of an intellectual nature). BLESSED_2 (IsBlessedByUnderstanding) types q.26 a.1-2 with existing vocabulary: intellect, universal perfection, goodness as to being and act in the respect of understanding. BLESSED_2 leaves out 'ex se', knowledge of one's own sufficiency and formal (rather than possibly virtual) understanding, so the two are not identified. BLESSED_1 is read the Thomist way (beatitude formally in the intellect, q.26 a.2); a Scotist reading (beatitude formally in the will's enjoyment) would be a third sense, not recorded here. One statement relates them: the open sense bridge 'Whatever is BLESSED_2 is BLESSED_1'. Only an argument that lists it in sense_bridges passes from BLESSED_2 to BLESSED_1 (the routes nineGiveDeiFiliusLordBlessedTyped and deiFiliusRootLordBlessedTyped); the controls of DeiFiliusLordBlessed show that without it a being with the nine can be BLESSED_2 and not BLESSED_1.
